map.UPDRS Part III 运动检查总分 = 各运动条目（每项 0 至 4）之: UPDRS Part III motor total = sum of motor items (each 0-4), max 56; 0 no symptoms, <=10 minimal, <=20 mild, <=30 moderate, <=40 mod-severe, >40 severe.

map.MDS-UPDRS第三部分是帕金森病运动严重程度评估的核心量表，评分≥10分通常: MDS-UPDRS Part III is the core scale for PD motor severity; a score >=10 usually meets the motor symptom criterion for PD diagnosis. A change >=3-5 (MCID) is clinically meaningful. Used for staging, medication efficacy and DBS pre-op evaluation. Assess in the "off" state (12h off medication).

map.运动 14 项合计 33 /56：中重度帕金森运动症状，建议调整用药。: Motor 14 items total 33 /56: mod-severe Parkinson's motor symptoms, suggest medication adjustment.
map.本运动部分 14 项每项 0~4，最高 56；全套含非运动更高。: This motor part 14 items each 0-4, max 56; full scale with non-motor is higher.
map.服药前后差值反映左旋多巴反应，利于方案优化。: Pre/post medication difference reflects levodopa response, aids regimen optimization.
map.关于「帕金森(UPDRS)运动评分器」: About the Parkinson's (UPDRS) Motor Score Assessor
map.UPDRS帕金森运动评分器，基于MDS-UPDRS第三部分运动检查，评估帕金森病: UPDRS Parkinson's motor assessor, based on MDS-UPDRS Part III motor examination, assesses Parkinson's motor symptom severity, including speech, face, tremor, rigidity, bradykinesia, etc. A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
